label: every DaytonaValidationError reads as capacity, so a bad image or invalid resource request is retried for five minutes and reported as 'capacity full' instead of failing fast
any exception carrying the limit wording reads as capacity, so a non-Daytona error is retried as if the org were full
the retry budget never runs out, so a build waits on a full org forever instead of settling sandbox_unavailable:capacity
a superseded preview job keeps retrying on a full org, holding a queue slot for a render nobody will view
a waiting publish is not re-stamped queued/waiting_for_capacity, so the row reads 'building' while nothing builds
the project lane reports capacity as no_sandbox, the prod bug: 'no build machine was free' and an agent saying the build server is down
the workspace VM passes the raw seconds value to Daytona as minutes again, keeping an idle 4 GiB box up for 60 hours
a stopped workspace VM is never resumed, so the 30-minute auto-stop breaks the agent's next tool call
a stopped workspace VM waits a day to be archived again, holding its 10 GiB on the org disk quota (three fill Tier 1)
the archive env override is ignored, so ops cannot tune how fast a stopped VM frees disk without a code change
an env archive interval of 0 is passed through, which Daytona reads as its MAXIMUM, so a stopped VM holds disk for days
an existing VM never gets the lifecycle re-applied, so VMs made under the one-day archive keep it until re-provisioned
the archive env has no ceiling, so a mistyped 1440 holds a stopped VM's disk for a day again
a VM caught stopping or archiving is not waited for, so start is refused and the tool call runs against a VM that is not running
a VM in an unusable state (error, unknown) is cached as started for a minute, so every tool call in that minute hits a dead VM
